experience.title: Software Engineer (Application Developer II)
highlights: Course Offerings site. Built LSU's public course catalog in .NET with the University Registrar, retiring a legacy system; it now serves 4,500+ monthly users. Designed its many-to-many SQL Server schema and tuned indexing with the DBAs.

Mainframe migration lead. Led LSU's DB2 mainframe decommissioning: designed the cutover with a parallel-run rollback and migrated 164 SQL views and stored procedures across three production apps. Wrote the playbook two engineers used to migrate two more.

Shared platform code. Built the Azure AD impersonation feature in LsuInfrastructureMVC, the internal .NET package LSU's web apps depend on, then rolled the new version out and regression tested it across every dependent application.

Workday Extend app. Built a course-certification web app for faculty, one of the first LSU put into production, and retired the legacy system behind it. Later added an assessment component admins configure without a deploy.

CKEditor 5 rewrite. Ported all 8 custom JavaScript/TypeScript editor plugins to CKEditor 5 for LSU's knowledge base (70K monthly visitors) with zero feature regressions, and made the full suite keyboard accessible to WCAG.

PHP to .NET 10. Rewrote a PHP inventory app in .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core with xUnit coverage, and moved LSU's campus-wide software distribution platform onto Azure AD / Entra ID SSO with SP-initiated SAML Single Logout.
Java and Spring Boot. Diagnosed a Tomcat 10 caching regression slowing every Spring app on the platform and shipped the fix, and patched an Apache Struts CVE across 10 Java apps.

Product ownership. Run requirements sessions and demos with the Registrar, Procurement, and academic offices; drive UAT through dev/QA/prod gates and schedule releases around course, inventory, and budget cycles.
Production support. Root-cause and fix authentication, data, and session bugs across 25+ enterprise web systems, and regression test every quarterly platform release.
